sources.title: AI Music Genre Converter - GitHub
sources.snippet: The AI Music Genre Converter allows users to upload a music file, automatically detect its genre using a trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), generate an optimized music transformation prompt using Google Gemini, and finally create a new version of the music in the selected target genre using Facebook MusicGen.
